items.exampleEn: There was a profound silence after the announcement.
items.exampleZh: 宣佈之後，現場一片深沉的寂靜。

items.exampleEn: Wearing a suit can add to a speaker's credibility.
items.exampleZh: 穿西裝可以增加講者的可信度。

items.exampleEn: The song is full of warm sentiment about home.
items.exampleZh: 這首歌充滿了對家鄉的溫暖情感。

items.exampleEn: She said "great weather" with heavy irony as the rain poured down.
items.exampleZh: 大雨傾盆時，她語帶諷刺地說「天氣真好」。

items.exampleEn: There is a lot of speculation about who will be the next coach.
items.exampleZh: 大家都在揣測誰會是下一任教練。

items.exampleEn: In all likelihood, the shop will close early today.
items.exampleZh: 那家店今天十之八九會提早打烊。

items.exampleEn: Scientists speculate that the lake formed thousands of years ago.
items.exampleZh: 科學家推測這座湖是在好幾千年前形成的。

items.exampleEn: Every report goes through careful scrutiny before it is published.
items.exampleZh: 每份報告在發表前都要經過仔細的審查。

items.sentenceEn: That book had a profound effect on how I see the world.
items.sentenceZh: 那本書深深影響了我看世界的方式。

items.audioEn: There is little likelihood of rain this weekend, so the picnic will go ahead.
items.audioZh: 這個週末下雨的可能性很低，所以野餐會照常舉行。
options: It will go ahead as planned

items.sentenceEn: Fans speculated about the band's next album for months.
items.sentenceZh: 歌迷們好幾個月來都在猜測樂團的下一張專輯。

items.sentenceEn: The irony is that the traffic map on my phone made me late.
items.sentenceZh: 諷刺的是，害我遲到的竟然是手機上的交通地圖。

items.stemEn: After the false report, the newspaper lost much of its ____.
items.stemZh: 那篇不實報導之後，這家報社失去了大部分的公信力。

items.stemEn: The new rules will come under close ____ from the public.
items.stemZh: 新規定將受到大眾的密切檢視。

items.passageEn: Last spring, rumors spread that a large shopping mall would be built next to our city's oldest park. The speculation stirred up strong public sentiment among residents, many of whom had walked in the park since childhood. Several websites published a succession of stories without checking the facts, and their credibility suffered when the city announced that no such plan existed. The irony was that the rumors brought new attention to the park. After months of public scrutiny, the city agreed to repair the park's paths and benches. Many residents believe the event had a profound effect on how people value green spaces.
items.passageZh: 去年春天，有謠言說我們城市最古老的公園旁邊要蓋一座大型購物中心。這個揣測在居民之間激起強烈的民意，其中很多人從小就在這座公園散步。好幾個網站沒有查證就接連刊出報導，等市府宣佈根本沒有這項計畫時，它們的可信度就受損了。諷刺的是，這些謠言反而讓公園重新受到關注。經過幾個月的大眾檢視，市府同意整修園內的步道和長椅。許多居民認為，這件事深深影響了人們看待綠地的方式。

questions.questionZh: 謠言說公園旁邊要蓋什麼？
這件事最後帶來什麼結果？
options: 市府答應整修公園設施

items.promptZh: 她不出席這場會議的可能性很高。
referenceEn: There is a high likelihood that she will not attend the meeting.
The likelihood of her missing the meeting is high.
rubricZh: likelihood 表示「可能性」（例如 a high likelihood that…、the likelihood of… 等）
「不出席」可寫，例如 not attend、miss 等

items.promptZh: 記者們紛紛猜測那位演員為什麼突然退出這部電影。
referenceEn: Reporters speculated about why the actor suddenly left the film.
Journalists speculated on the reason the actor suddenly quit the movie.
rubricZh: 「猜測」用 speculate，可接 about、on 或 that 子句（例如 speculated about why… 等）
「退出」可寫，例如 left、quit、pulled out of 等
時態配合內容（例如 speculated、have speculated、are speculating 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：自查（執行長釋義原則）：sentiment 例句「I share your sentiment, but I disagree with your plan.」示範的是次要義，第一義應為最常用義「情緒、感受」
